blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Answering questions about long videos often requires connecting events involving the same objects across hours or days.
Chronological descriptions and text-derived entities can leave physical identity unresolved: different objects may share a description, while observations of the same object remain disconnected across events.
Retrieving relevant events therefore does not necessarily recover the “biography” of the particular entity a question concerns.
To address this, we introduce Grounded Entity Biographies (GEB), a long-video memory framework that groups visually grounded observations of the same physical instance across clips into retrievable biographies while preserving the context of each moment.
During question answering, the biography is retrieved alongside episodic evidence, allowing the model to follow an entity through events using identity links established during memory construction.
Evaluations across four benchmarks, including day-long and week-long recordings, demonstrate improvements over prior memory frameworks in both multiple-choice and open-ended question answering.
On EgoLifeQA, GEB achieves 72.0 % 72.0\% accuracy, 4.4 4.4 percentage points above the best published result.
Ablations show that grounded identity association and biography reading both contribute to the gains, which additional descriptions alone do not fully recover.
blocks.zh:
回答关于长视频的问题,往往需要将涉及相同物体的事件连接起来,跨越数小时或数天。
编年史描述和文本衍生的实体可以留下实体身份未解决的问题:不同的对象可能共享一个描述,而同一对象的观测仍然在事件间断开.
因此,检索有关事件不一定能够恢复特定实体所关切的“传记”。
为了解决这个问题,我们引入了地基实体生物图,这是一个长视频的记忆框架,将同一物理实例的视基观测在片段之间组合成可检索的生物图,同时保留每个时刻的背景。
在回答问题时,该传记与零星证据一起检索,使模型能够利用在内存构建过程中建立的身份链接通过事件跟随一个实体.
包括全天和全周录音在内的四项基准的评价表明,在多选择和开放式问题回答方面,比以前的记忆框架有所改善。
在EgoLifeQA上,GEB实现72.0% 72.0QQ精度,比最佳公布结果高4.4个百分点.
叙述表明,基于身份的关联和传记都有助于取得这些成果,而仅靠补充说明并不能完全恢复。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: History can be organized around events or around the subjects who took part. A chronicle follows events through time; a biography follows a subject through those events. Long-video memory needs both perspectives: it must recover what happened at a particular moment and connect what happened to the same person or object across hours or days. The latter requires deciding which scattered observations concern the same physical entity. Without this correspondence, a detailed record of moments leaves the biography of an entity incomplete.
blocks.zh: 历史可以围绕活动来组织,也可以围绕参与的主体来组织. 编年史会随时间而变化;传记会随事件而变化。 长视频记忆需要两种视角:它必须恢复在特定时刻发生的事情,并将发生的事情连接到同一个人或物体上,历时数小时或数天. 后者要求决定哪些分散的观察涉及同一个实体。 没有这些信件,详细的瞬间记录使得一个实体的传记不完整.

blocks.en:
Consider the question in Figure 1 : Did the mug I drank coffee from end up in the dishwasher? The striped red mug was used for coffee and later seen empty on the counter; a different, solid red mug was placed in the dishwasher. A descriptive memory may retrieve both “coffee is poured into a red mug” and “a red mug is placed in the dishwasher.”
Both descriptions can be accurate, yet their shared wording does not establish that the events involve the same instance. Retrieving relevant events is therefore insufficient without resolving whose biography they belong to.
blocks.zh:
考虑一下图1中的问题:我喝咖啡的杯子是不是在洗碗机里? 条纹红色的杯子用于咖啡,后来看到柜台上是空的;一个不同的,坚固的红色杯子被放在洗碗机里. 描述性记忆可以收回“将咖啡倒进红色杯子”和“将红色杯子放在洗碗机中”。 “
这两种描述都可能是准确的,但它们的共同措辞并不能确定事件涉及同一事件. 因此,在不解决属于谁的传记的情况下,检索相关活动是不够的。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Moments record events; persistent entities connect them into biographies. To answer whether the mug used for coffee ended up in the dishwasher, a memory must know which physical mug took part in each event. A descriptive memory may retrieve “coffee is poured into a red mug” and “a red mug is placed in the dishwasher” yet cannot tell whether the two mugs are the same.
blocks.zh: 图1:记录事件;持久性实体将它们与传记联系起来。 为了回答咖啡用的杯子是否最后出现在洗碗机上,必须记得每个事件都参加了哪个身体上的杯子. 描述性记忆可能取回“咖啡倒进一个红色杯子”和“一个红色杯子放在洗碗机中”,但无法确定两个杯子是否相同。

blocks.en: Memory frameworks make long recordings searchable through temporal descriptions and semantic relations ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Yeo et al., 2026 ) , with recent structured memory frameworks also consolidating entity mentions into cross-time narratives ( Li et al., 2026a ) . When correspondence is derived from language, two related limitations remain. First, descriptions can conflate or fragment the biographies of physical objects: different objects may share a name, while one object may be described differently as its state, location, or activity changes. Second, retrieving an observation may not reveal the other encounters of that particular instance, especially across recording sessions, where temporal proximity and continuous tracking no longer connect observations. Without identity established in the memory itself, retrieval and reasoning must reconstruct which moments belong together from the evidence available for each question.
blocks.zh: 记忆框架通过时间描述和语义关系(Wang et al.,2024;Yeo et al.,2026)使得长时间的录音可以搜索,最近结构化的记忆框架也将实体提及整合为跨时段的叙述(Li et al.,2026a). 当信函来自语言时,仍然有两个相关的限制。 首先,描述可以对物理物体的传记进行拼接或分解:不同的物体可能共享一个名称,而一个物体可能因其状态,位置,或活动变化而被不同描述. 第二,检索某项观测可能无法揭示该特定实例的其他遭遇,特别是在记录期间,在记录期间,时间接近和连续跟踪不再连接观测。 如果记忆本身没有确定身份,则检索和推理必须从每个问题的现有证据中重建哪些时刻是共同的。

blocks.en: We introduce Grounded Entity Biographies (GEB), a long-video memory framework that organizes observations into biographies of inferred physical instances while preserving the context and visual evidence of each encounter (Figure 2 ). GEB grounds each observation in views of the instance and its surrounding activity, then associates observations across clips using visual and contextual evidence, and rejects a match when the video shows two different physical instances. At question time, a retrieved observation becomes an entry point: retrieval follows same-instance edges to the other observations of the same inferred instance and can reach their episodic context and source evidence. Further, the biography excerpt presented to the controller also lists the observations not yet inspected, giving the controller concrete targets for further search.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了地基实体生物图(GEB),这是一个长视频记忆框架,它组织观测到所推断的物理事件的生物图,同时保留每次接触的背景和视觉证据(图2)。 GEB将每个观察都以对实例及其周围活动的看法作为依据,然后利用视觉和背景证据将截图的观察联系起来,并在视频显示两个不同的物理实例时拒绝匹配. 在提问时,检索到的观察会成为一个进入点:检索会跟随同一推断实例的其他观察的相同边际,并可以到达其偶发背景和来源证据. 此外,提交给控制员的传记摘录还列出了尚未检查的观测结果,使控制员有具体的目标进行进一步搜索。

blocks.en: We evaluate GEB on day-long and week-long recordings, covering multiple-choice and open-ended question answering ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . On EgoLifeQA, GEB achieves 72.0 % 72.0\% accuracy versus 67.6 % 67.6\% reported by MAGIC-Video, the strongest published memory framework, while using the same retrieval controller, the same answer model, and the same retrieval limits. The fraction of questions whose evidence window reaches the answering context rises from 37.6 % 37.6\% to 58.9 % 58.9\% , indicating better access to relevant moments. Ablations show: indexing descriptions without physical-instance association recovers only part of the gain; removing the same-instance edges, the edges to episodic context, or the biography text each reduces accuracy.
blocks.zh: 在EgoLifeQA上,GEB的准确度为72.0%,而MAGIC-Video报告的比例为67.6%,而MAGIC-Video则是最强的出版内存框架,同时使用相同的检索控制器,相同的答案模型和相同的检索限制。 证据窗口进入解答背景的问题从37.6%的37.6%上升到58.9%的58.9%,这表明进入相关时刻的机会更好。 缩写显示:没有物理内涵关联的索引描述只回收部分收益;去除相同内涵边缘,边缘到偶发上下文,或传记文字各降低精度.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • Grounded entity biographies: a memory representation and construction approach that links visually grounded observations into persistent entity biographies while retaining their event context and supporting evidence. • Retrieval and reading through identity: a mechanism that connects episodes through shared physical entities and presents biography excerpts that support reasoning and guide further search. • Empirical validation and analysis: improvements on long-video question answering under matched reasoning components, with evidence-access diagnostics and ablations examining the roles of grounding, association, and biography reading.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下: 基地实体传记:一种记忆表达和构建方法,将视网膜观测与持久性实体传记联系起来,同时保留其事件背景和佐证证据。 · 通过身份检索和阅读:一种通过共享物理实体连接各集的机制,并介绍支持推理和指导进一步搜索的传记节录. • 经验验证和分析:在相应推理部分下改进长视频问题回答,并进行证据获取诊断和模拟,审查地面、联系和传记阅读的作用。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Long-video memory and agentic retrieval. Long-video models extend the amount of visual context they can process through memory compression and hierarchical token reduction ( Song et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Retrieval-based approaches access selected evidence on demand: VideoAgent iteratively gathers information with visual tools ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , while WorldMM coordinates retrieval from episodic, semantic, and visual memories ( Yeo et al., 2026 ) . Ego-R1 learns to compose tool calls for long-horizon reasoning ( Tian et al., 2026 ) , and ReMA recursively manages a multimodal belief state ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . GEB complements these retrieval strategies by connecting a matched observation to other events involving the same physical instance.
blocks.zh: 长视频内存和代理检索. Long-video模型通过内存压缩和分级符号还原来扩展可处理的视觉上下文量(Song等人,2024年;Li等人,2026年b). 基于检索的方法按要求获取选定的证据: VideoAgent用视觉工具迭代地收集信息(Wang等人,2024年),而WorldMM则协调从史诗,语义和视觉记忆的检索(Yeo等人,2026年). Ego-R1学习作曲工具呼吁长视推理(Tian等人,2026年),ReMA递归性地管理着一种多式信仰状态(Chen等人,2026年). GEB通过将匹配的观测与涉及同一物理实例的其他事件联系起来来补充这些检索策略.

blocks.en:
Entity memory. Entity-centered memory frameworks retain information about recurring people and objects. VideoAgent tracks and re-identifies objects within a video and keeps an object-occurrence database ( Fan et al., 2024 ) ; AMEGO links the interaction tracklets of one object and records where it is used ( Goletto et al., 2024 ) . M3-Agent gives the people in a video face and voice identities beside episodic and semantic text ( Long et al., 2026 ) , and Embodied VideoAgent maintains persistent objects from egocentric video with depth and pose sensing ( Fan et al., 2025 ) .
GEB organizes observations of the same physical instance into biographies while retaining event contexts. These biographies support retrieval across events and guide further search through references to other recorded appearances.
blocks.zh:
实体记忆. 以实体为中心的记忆框架保留关于反复出现的人和物体的信息。 VideoAgent跟踪并重新识别视频中的对象,并保持一个对象聚合数据库(Fan等人,2024年);AMEGO将一个对象的交互轨道和使用它的记录连接起来(Goletto等人,2024年). M3-Agent在短篇和语义文字(Long等人,2026年)之外,
GEB在保留事件背景的同时,将同一物理实例的观测组织到传记中. 这些传记支持跨事件的检索,并通过引用其他记录的外观来指导进一步搜索.

blocks.en:
Structured memory and relational retrieval. Graph-based retrieval connects evidence through extracted entities and relations. GraphRAG organizes document collections through entity graphs and community summaries ( Edge et al., 2024 ) ; HippoRAG and HippoRAG 2 support associative retrieval through knowledge graphs and links to source passages ( Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ; Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ) . For video, EGAgent and EgoGraph construct temporal entity graphs from transcripts and scene descriptions ( Rege et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . MAGIC-Video builds a multimodal memory graph over its captions, using entity nodes for names extracted by a language model and consolidated across time, augmented by topic and event chains ( Li et al., 2026a ) .
Language-derived entity links can merge distinct physical instances
or split one instance across names. GEB associates observations
using visual and contextual evidence, with separation in shared
frames vetoing a match.

GraphRAG通过实体图表和社区摘要组织文件收集工作(Edge等人,2024年);HippoRAG和HippoRAG 2支持通过知识图表和源段落链接进行关联检索(Gutiérrez等人,2024年;Gutiérrez等人,2025年)。 对于视频,EGAgent和EgoGraph从文字记录和场景描述中构建了时间实体图(Rege等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年). blocks.en: 3 Grounded Entity Biographies
blocks.zh: 3 基础实体生物图

blocks.en: Grounded Entity Biographies (GEB) connects persistent entity biographies to episodic memory. We define this representation (Sections 3.1 – 3.2 ), then describe how grounded association constructs biographies and retrieval follows them across events (Sections 3.3 – 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 地基实体生物图(GEB)将持久性实体生物图与内存连接起来. 我们界定这种表述方式(第3.1至3.2节),然后说明有根据的关联如何构建传记,并在各种事件中加以检索(第3.3至3.4节)。

Visually grounded observations of each instance are associated across clips into a persistent biography; here the blue hand mixer is linked across days, each observation keeping its description, its source frames and its episode context. blocks.en: 3.2 Connecting Biographies to Episodic Memory
blocks.zh: 3.2 将生物图与Episodic记忆连接

blocks.en: A biography connects encounters with the same subject, while an episode preserves the surrounding activity and other participants needed to interpret them. Identifying who helped with the mixer, for example, requires context about the people involved. In our memory, we therefore link each encounter to its biography, surrounding episode, and source video.
blocks.zh: 一部传记片连接了同一主题的遭遇,而一集则保留了周围的活动和其他参与者需要解读的活动. 例如,确定谁帮助了搅拌机,需要了解所涉人员的背景。 在我们的记忆中,我们将每次相遇都与其传记,环绕剧集,以及源视频联系起来.

blocks.en: A persistent entity node u k u_{k} represents one inferred physical instance, such as the blue mixer across days, without requiring continuous visibility. Observation nodes retain its individual encounters. Episode nodes hold scene descriptions at multiple temporal scales, such as Shure’s actions and dialogue while handling the mixer (Figure 2 ). Source-clip nodes reference the original video. An episode and source clip may cover the same interval but supply different evidence: a contextual description and its supporting frames.

blocks.en: Writing a biography requires attributing an event to the correct visible subject and recognizing that subject when it reappears. GEB separates these decisions: grounded descriptions preserve individual encounters, while cross-clip association determines which encounters share an entity.
blocks.zh: 撰写传记需要将某一事件归于正确的可见主体,并在该主体重新出现时予以识别. GEB将这些决定分开:有根据的描述保留了个人的遭遇,而交叉的clip关联则决定了哪个遭遇共享一个实体.

blocks.en: Grounding encounters in their context. An open-vocabulary detector and a within-clip tracker group repeated detections into observations, providing multiple views of a subject within one encounter. To describe each encounter, a vision-language model jointly reads subject crops, scene frames, and available timestamped narration and dialogue. Crops reveal distinguishing details, scene frames show interactions involving the subject, and text supplies surrounding event context. The prompt instructs the model to establish the subject visually and use textual context only when it concerns that subject. This addresses a central attribution problem: an action described near an object need not involve that object.
blocks.zh: 在他们的背景中遭遇地面。 一个开放式的伏车探测器和一个内部的clip跟踪器组重复探测成观测,在一次接触中提供一个对象的多种观点. 为了描述每次相遇,一个视觉语言模型联合阅读主题作物、场景框架以及可用时间标注的叙述和对话。 裁剪揭示了显著的细节,场景框架显示涉及主体的相互作用,以及围绕事件背景的文本供给. 即时指示模型只在涉及该主题时才以视觉方式确定主题并使用文字上下文. 这解决了一个中心归属问题:描述的某物体附近的行动不需要涉及该物体.

blocks.en: Associating encounters conservatively. For each new observation, we decide whether to append it to an existing biography or start a new one. A mistaken association creates false paths between events, so a match must have positive support and remain consistent with the retained evidence.
blocks.zh: 参与的遭遇是保守的。 对于每一个新的观察,我们决定是把它附在现有的传记上,还是开始一个新的传记. 错误的关联在事件之间制造虚假路径,因此匹配必须获得积极的支持,并与保留的证据保持一致.

blocks.en: 3.4 Reading the Memory
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 读取内存

blocks.en: A question may identify an entity through one encounter but concern another. Retrieval uses the matched encounter to enter its biography and recover surrounding evidence. A language-model controller ( Li et al., 2026a ) reads the question and accumulated evidence, then issues another search or passes deduplicated biographies, episode excerpts, and source frames to the answer model.
blocks.zh: 一个问题可以通过一次接触确定一个实体,但涉及另一个实体。 检索使用匹配的遭遇输入其传记并收回周围的证据. 一个语言模型控制器(Li et al., 2026a)读出问题和积累的证据,然后再发布一次搜索或通过破译的传记,插曲节选,以及解答模型的源框.

blocks.en: Retrieving through identity and context. Observation descriptions and episode captions are indexed together, semantically and lexically; a query’s initial matches come from this shared index and from visual matches to source clips. Relevance propagates from these matches through entity membership to other observations of the same inferred instance, and through context links to their surrounding episodes. We implement this propagation with Personalized PageRank ( Haveliwala, 2002 ) and combine its scores with query-text similarity for ranking. Entity nodes transmit relevance; the returned evidence consists of observations, episodes, and source clips.
blocks.zh: 通过身份和上下文检索。 观察描述和插曲字幕是一起编成索引的,从成语和语法上编成的;一个查询的初始匹配来自这个共享索引,从视觉匹配到源剪辑. 关联性通过实体成员身份传播到同一推断实例的其他观察,并通过其周围事件的背景链接传播。 我们用个性化的PageRank(Haveliwala,2002年)来进行这种传播,并将它的分数与查询文本的相似性结合起来进行排名。 实体节点传递相关性;返回的证据包括观察、事件和源剪辑。

blocks.en: These records compete within a shared retrieval budget. Limits on selected appearances, both overall and per entity, preserve room for episodic context and prevent a frequently observed subject from dominating. Relation weights and budget settings are specified in Appendix A . For timestamped questions, retrieval and rendering are restricted to memory records preceding the query time.
blocks.zh: 这些记录在共享检索预算中竞争。 总体和每个实体对特定外观的限制,为偶发背景保留了空间,防止经常观察到的主体占主导地位。 关系权重和预算设置在附录A中规定。 对于时间戳的问题,检索和渲染仅限于查询时间之前的内存记录.

blocks.en:
Reading a biography and extending the search. For each entity, the biography excerpt contains its observations selected through the current retrieval round, ordered by time.
Each block retains the entity identifier, timestamps, and stored descriptions. Other recorded appearances that have not been selected are summarized by times and counts, giving the controller concrete targets for subsequent searches. The biography therefore provides both evidence about the subject and access to parts of its history that remain to be inspected.
blocks.zh:
阅读传记并扩展搜索. 对于每个实体,传记节选包含了通过当前检索回合选择的,按时间顺序排列的观察.
每个块保留实体标识符,时间戳,并存储描述. 其他未选中的录制外观按时间和计数进行汇总,使控制器有具体的目标进行后续搜索. 因此,该传记提供了有关该主题的证据,并提供了尚待检查的部分历史资料。

blocks.en: Conservative association can leave one physical instance under multiple identifiers. When biographies that share a name are retrieved together, an accompanying note distinguishes pairs with visual evidence of separation from those whose identity remains unresolved. Different identifiers alone are not treated as proof of different objects. Linked episodic evidence also provides context for checking the account of an observation; the reading prompt gives the episode precedence when the two descriptions conflict.
blocks.zh: 保守协会可以在多个识别码下留下一个物理实例。 当共同名称的传记被一起检索时,随附的注释将带有视觉证据的对称与身份仍未解决的对称区分开来. 单是不同的识别器,并不能作为不同物体的证据。 链接的偶发证据也为检查某项观察的叙述提供了上下文;在两种描述冲突时,阅读提示给予插曲优先.

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate question answering, access to supporting moments, and the contributions of identity association, episodic connections, and biography reading.
blocks.zh: 我们评价回答问题,获得支持的机会, 以及身份联系的贡献, 零星的联系, 和传记阅读。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Benchmarks. Our evaluation covers complementary demands of video memory. EgoLifeQA ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and Ego-R1-Bench ( Tian et al., 2026 ) test multiple-choice answering over approximately 52 hours of participant A1’s week, using 500 and 50 questions, respectively. Only recordings preceding each question’s timestamp are accessible. MM-Lifelong ( Chen et al., 2026 ) tests open-ended answering over the same week (Test@Week) and a 23.6-hour gameplay stream (Test@Day), with the complete recording accessible. The same EgoLife memory supports both multiple-choice benchmarks and Test@Week without rebuilding. MultiHop-EgoQA ( Chen et al., 2025 ) tests questions requiring evidence from separate moments: it contains 1,080 questions over 360 three-minute Ego4D clips ( Grauman et al., 2022 ) . Its annotated evidence intervals allow us to evaluate whether retrieval reaches all required moments. Memory construction uses video without audio.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们的评价涵盖视频记忆的补充需求。 EgoLifeQA(Yang等人,2025年)和Ego-R1-Bench(Tian等人,2026年)测试多选择回答大约52小时的参与者. A1周,分别使用500和50题. 只有每个问题的时间戳之前的录音才能获取。 MM-长寿 (Chen et al., 2026)测试在同周开放的回答(Test@Week)和23.6小时的游戏播放流(Test@Day),完整的录音可以访问. 同样的EgoLife内存支持多选择基准和Test@Week而不重建. MultiHop-EgoQA 数据 (Chen等人,2025年)测试需要不同时刻证据的问题:其中包含360个3分钟Ego4D片段的1,080个问题(Grauman等人,2022年). 其附加说明的证据间隔使我们能够评估检索是否达到所有必要的时间。 内存构造使用没有音频的视频.

blocks.en: Comparisons. We compare with general, long-video, and agentic video models, distinguishing published results from our runs in the tables. For comparisons among memory frameworks, MAGIC-Video ( Li et al., 2026a ) , WorldMM ( Yeo et al., 2026 ) , and GEB use Qwen3.5-35B as controller and answer model. Their EgoLifeQA and Ego-R1-Bench baseline results are taken from Li et al. (2026a) . On MM-Lifelong and MultiHop-EgoQA, we run the released implementations. GEB and MAGIC-Video share the episodic captions, topic and event summaries, and retrieval limits. WorldMM retains its own episodic, semantic, and visual stores. Appendix A specifies retrieval-unit, search-round and frame limits, and Appendix C the per-benchmark protocol, including WorldMM’s per-store retrieval. No-memory reference rows evaluate the answer model with sampled video evidence. On MultiHop-EgoQA, this reference receives frames spanning the entire clip, whereas memory frameworks select evidence through retrieval.
blocks.zh: 比较. 我们比较一般的,长视频的, 和代理视频模型, 区分公布的结果 与我们的运行在表格。 在对内存框架进行比较时,MAGIC-Video(Li等人,2026a),WorldMM(Yeo等人,2026),以及GEB使用Quen3.5-35B作为控制器和答案模型. 其EgoLifeQA和Ego-R1-Bench的基准结果取自Li等人(2026a). 在MM-Lifelong和MultiHop-EgoQA上,我们运行发布执行. GEB和MAGIC-Video分享了短篇标题、专题和事件摘要以及检索限制。 WorldMM保留了自己的零星、语义和视觉商店。 附 录 一个指定了检索单元,搜索回合和帧限制,以及附录C的每个基准协议,包括WorldMM的每个商店检索. 无记忆参考行用抽样视频证据评价答案模型. 在MultiHop-EgoQA上,这个引用接收横跨整个剪辑的帧,而内存框架通过检索选择证据.

blocks.en: Evaluation. We report multiple-choice accuracy on EgoLifeQA and Ego-R1-Bench, and the benchmark’s GPT-5-judged accuracy on MM-Lifelong. MultiHop-EgoQA evaluates answer quality and temporal grounding. We use its released scoring code and its grading prompt with an independent gpt-oss-120b judge. Grading uses the 724 questions with a reference answer. Ego-R1-Bench results are averaged over three seeds, and our memory-framework evaluations on MM-Lifelong and MultiHop-EgoQA each report the mean over three runs. Detailed scoring protocols appear in Appendix C . Uncertainty estimates are summarized with the main results below.

blocks.en: Open-ended answering across recordings. On Test@Week, GEB reaches 36.83%, exceeding the strongest competing result, WorldMM, by 5.41 points. On the gameplay Test@Day split, its lead over the strongest competitor, ReMA, is 0.83 points. The reported confidence intervals exclude zero for EgoLifeQA, Ego-R1-Bench, and Test@Week, but include zero for Test@Day (Appendix Table 14 ). GEB exceeds both memory-framework baselines on each split. These results extend the evaluation to free-form answers and a recording domain with recurring game entities, with a clearer advantage on the week-long benchmark.
blocks.zh: 录音时可自由回答。 在Test@Week上,GEB达到36.83%,超过了最强的竞争结果WorldMM,比5.41分. 在游戏播放测试@Day拆分中,它在最强的竞争对手ReMA的领先点为0.83分. 所报告的信任间隔不包括EgoLifeQA、Ego-R1-Bench和Test@Week的零,但包括Test@Day的零(附录表14)。 GEB在每个拆分上都超过了两个内存框架基线. 这些结果将评价扩展至自由格式的答案和一个有反复出现的游戏实体的录制域,在长达一周的基准上具有更明确的优势.

blocks.en: Answering and temporal grounding. MultiHop-EgoQA additionally tests whether a system identifies the moments supporting its answer (Table 2 ). GEB leads the compared memory frameworks on every reported metric: its answer score increases from WorldMM’s 2.74 to 3.11, while mIoU increases by 1.6 points. GEB also exceeds every model the benchmark reports in IoU@0.3 and mIoU, including GeLM, which is fine-tuned on the benchmark’s training set. The improvements in both measures motivate examining which evidence reaches the answer model. The answer model reading 60 frames of the whole clip without a memory scores higher still, showing the gap that remains to answering from the complete clip.
blocks.zh: 回答和时间定位。 MultiHop-EgoQA另外测试一个系统是否识别了支持其答案的时刻(表2 )。 GEB领导每个报告度量的比较内存框架:其答题分数从世界MM的2.74增至3.11,而MIOU则增加1.6分. GEB也超过了IoU@0.3和mIoU中的所有基准报告模型,包括GeLM,它根据基准的培训集进行了微调. 这两项措施的改进都促使人们审查哪些证据达到了答案模式。 解答模型读取了整段片段的60帧,没有内存分数的分数仍然较高,显示了从完整片段解答时留下的差距.

blocks.en: An evidence hit on EgoLifeQA occurs when a received caption or described observation overlaps the annotated evidence window. Observations contribute their description-context windows, which may extend beyond visible spans (Appendix C ). MultiHop-EgoQA complete evidence coverage ( All in Table 3 ) requires overlap with every annotated interval. These measures evaluate received context, while temporal grounding evaluates intervals predicted in answers. Retrieved duration ( Clip ) is the union of received intervals divided by duration, accounting for differences in the amount of retrieved context.

To assess whether the gain follows simply from retrieving more of the recording, we increase MAGIC-Video’s MultiHop-EgoQA allowance from three to six units per round. blocks.en: Physical identity beyond additional descriptions. Without association, each observation forms its own entity; name-keyed identity groups observations by described name. Both retain all descriptions under the full model’s retrieval-unit and frame limits and deliver comparable context, but reduce accuracy by 3.4 and 2.8 points. Appending descriptions to captions removes observation and entity structure and costs 3.8 points at a matched answering-context budget. These controls support physical-instance organization beyond additional descriptions.
blocks.zh: 超出额外描述的物理特征. 没有关联,每个观察都构成自己的实体;按名称划分的身份组按所描述的名称进行观察. 两者都保留了完整模型的检索单元和帧限制下的所有描述,并提供可比较的上下文,但精确度降低3.4和2.8点. 对标题进行附加说明会删除观察和实体结构,并在匹配的应答文本预算中花费3.8分. 这些控制能支持超出额外描述的物理内测组织.

blocks.en: Connections to identity and event context. Removing same-instance edges while retaining entity assignments costs 3.0 points. Disconnecting observations from episodes and source clips costs 3.8 points, and removing both edge families costs 5.0 (Appendix Table 15 ). These results support both following identity across events and recovering the context of each observation.
blocks.zh: 连接到身份和事件背景 。 在保留实体任务的同时去除相同的边缘需要3.0分。 从片段和源片断中断开观测值需要3.8分,去除两个边缘家庭需要5.0分(附录表15 ). 这些结果既有助于跟踪各种事件的特征,又有助于恢复每项观察的背景。

blocks.en: Biographies for answering and further search. Withholding biography text from both models while retaining the indexed memory costs 4.0 points. Withholding it only from the answer model while keeping the controller’s searches fixed reduces accuracy by 1.2 points. Removing references to observations not yet selected costs 1.8 points. The text-removal controls establish benefits beyond graph retrieval, while the reference removal supports using biographies to guide further search.
blocks.zh: 用于回答和进一步搜索的生物图. 保留两个模型的传记文本,同时保留索引内存成本4.0分. 仅从回答模型中取出,而保持控制器的搜索固定,精度降低1.2分. 删除对尚未选定成本的观察的引用 1.8 点。 文本删除控制确立了图检索以外的惠益,而引用删除则支持使用传记来指导进一步搜索.

blocks.en: Consistency across benchmarks. On MM-Lifelong, appending descriptions to captions costs 3.25 points on Test@Week and 5.08 on Test@Day; withholding biography text with the index retained costs 6.75 and 2.33, respectively. Neither variant recovers full performance on either split (Appendix Table 9 ). On MultiHop-EgoQA, both association and biography-text removal reduce complete evidence coverage, with confidence intervals excluding zero, but have smaller effects on answer scores (Table 3 ). Appendix E illustrates how biographies and context resolve concrete questions.
blocks.zh: 各种基准的一致性。 在MM-Lifelong上,标题的附加说明在Test@Week和Test@Day上分别花费3.25分和5.08分;保留带有索引的传记文本分别保留了6.75和2.33美元的费用。 两个变体都无法在两个分数上恢复全部性能(附录表9)。 在MultiHop-EgoQA上,联想和传记文本删除都降低了完整的证据覆盖面,置信间隔排除为0,但对答案分数的影响较小(表3 ). 附 录 E说明了传记和背景如何解决具体问题。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Long-video memory must preserve not only what happened, but also which people and objects connect events across time. We introduced Grounded Entity Biographies, a framework that links visually grounded observations of the same physical instance while retaining each observation’s context and source evidence. These biographies make persistent entities bridges across episodes, allowing retrieval to follow an entity’s history and use previously recorded appearances to guide further search. Evaluations across four benchmarks demonstrate improvements in multiple-choice and open-ended question answering, including week-long recordings. Evidence analysis shows better access to relevant moments, while ablations support the contributions of grounded identity association and biography reading beyond additional descriptions alone. These findings highlight the value of organizing video memory around enduring subjects alongside the events in which they participate.
blocks.zh: 长视频记忆不仅必须保存所发生的事情,而且还必须保存哪些人和物体将各种事件联系起来。 我们引入了地基实体生物图,这个框架将同一物理实例的视基观测联系起来,同时保留每个观测的背景和源证据。 这些传记使持续的实体跨越各个事件,使检索能够跟踪一个实体的历史,并利用先前记录的外观指导进一步搜索。 对四项基准的评价显示,在多选择和无限制回答问题方面,包括为期一周的录音方面,情况有所改善。 证据分析表明,可以更好地接触相关时刻,而编剧则支持基于身份的关联和传记读取超出其他描述范围的贡献。 这些调查结果突出了围绕持久主题组织视频记忆以及参与的活动的价值。

blocks.en: The EgoLife week is processed as 6,266 thirty-second clips of 1408 × 1408 1408\times 1408 video, sampled at 10 fps. YOLOE-26x-seg in its prompt-free mode detects objects on every sampled frame ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , BoT-SORT links the detections into tracks within a clip ( Aharon et al., 2022 ; Tang et al., 2023 ) , and duplicate tracks of one object are merged. Following VideoAgent ( Fan et al., 2024 ) , tracks that the tracker split are regrouped by CLIP and DINOv2 appearance similarity ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ) , and tracks seen in the same frame are never grouped. A group visible for at least two seconds becomes an observation and keeps representative crops, its time span, and its source episode; whole-frame and watermark boxes are discarded.
blocks.zh: "EgoLife周"以6,266第三十二段1408×14081408\times1408视频的剪辑进行处理,在10英尺处取样. YOLOE-26x-seg在其快速无阻模式中检测每个采样框上的物体(Wang等人,2025a),BOT-SORT将探测器连接到剪辑内的轨迹(Aharon等人,2022;Tang等人,2023),一个物体的重复轨迹被合并. 继VideoAgent(Fan et al., 2024 )之后,追踪器分裂的轨迹被CLIP和DINOv2的外观相似性重新组合(Radford et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ),在同一帧中看到的轨迹从未被分组. 至少有两秒钟可见的一组成为观测对象,并保留具有代表性的作物,其时间跨度,以及它的源集;全帧和水印盒被丢弃.

blocks.en: Each observation is described by one call to a locally served vision-language model ( Qwen3.5-35B ). The call sees four crops at 448 px, scene frames at 768 px sampled at 1 fps over the observation’s span (3 to 30) with the subject boxed, and the recording’s own caption and transcript within ± 40 \pm 40 s. It returns the object’s name, a one-paragraph summary that is used as the retrieval text, an event description, whether the object is a person, its location, and its stable attributes.
blocks.zh: 每种观察都通过一次呼叫(Quen3.5-35B )当地服务的视觉语言模型来描述. 电话在448px看到4种作物,在768px的场景框上在1fps的观察间距上取样(3至30),并标注对象,录音在±40\pm40s之内自带字幕和记录誊本。 它返回对象名称,一个段落摘要,用作检索文本,事件描述,对象是否是人,位置,以及其稳定属性.

blocks.en: One vision call per clip assigns the people on screen to the recording’s cast jointly, and a text model ( gpt-oss-120b ) distills each person’s clothing for the day from those assignments. An entity matched to one unambiguous profile takes its name and carries it to its observations on the other days, and an entity that two days name differently carries no name across days. The name labels the entity, and the description text is left as written. This stage runs on the EgoLife recording, whose seven participants are named; the Test@Day livestream has no cast, so its entities carry only the names written in their descriptions.
blocks.zh: 每个片段一个视觉呼叫将屏幕上的人分配到录音的一起投影,一个文本模型(gpt-oss-120b)从这些任务中提炼每个人当天的衣服。 一个与一个明确特征相匹配的实体取其名称,并在其他日期将其带入其观察,一个两天名称不同的实体则不带任何名称。 名称标注实体,描述文本保留为书面. 这个舞台运行在"EgoLife"的录音上,其七个参与者被命名;Test@Day livestream没有投影,所以其实体只携带其描述中写的名字.

blocks.en: Observation texts are embedded with the caption encoder ( Qwen3-Embedding-4B , 2560-d) and indexed in the same lexical index as the captions. Edge weights are episode context 1.0, visual provenance 0.8, and same-instance 0.5. On EgoLife, the episodic memory uses 30-second, 3-minute, 10-minute, and 1-hour scales. Personalized PageRank uses a damping factor of 0.85, and each returned node is ranked by the product of its PageRank score and its query–text cosine similarity. An entity node exists for every entity with two or more observations. It routes relevance between the observations and is not scored as a unit itself. Each retrieved observation is one unit of the round’s budget; the retrieved observations of one entity are rendered together as its biography excerpt, the Retrieved entity block of Figure 5 . Retrieval on every benchmark allows at most five rounds and 64 frames. Week-scale retrieval uses 16 units per round, and at most six of the units may be observations, at most three of them from one entity and with no limit on the number of entities. MultiHop-EgoQA uses three units per round, of which at most one may be an observation. On every benchmark the controller and the answer model are Qwen3.5-35B , called either on a locally served vLLM instance, its context window extended to 1M tokens with YaRN, or through OpenRouter’s qwen3.5-flash endpoint, the hosted form of the same checkpoint. GEB and MAGIC-Video share one episodic memory: the 30-second captions and the topic and event summaries derived from them, injected after each search. The summaries are extracted once from the captions and do not depend on the entities. For a question asked at time t t , the memory is re-indexed to the nodes before t t .
blocks.zh: 观察文本与标题编码器(Qune3-Embedding-4B , 2560-d)嵌入,与标题索引相同。 边重是插曲上下文1.0,视觉出处0.8,以及同声0.5. 在"EgoLife"上,癫痫记忆采用30秒,3分钟,10分钟,1小时的尺度. 个性化的PageRank使用0.85的坝因子,每个返回的节点按其PageRank分数及其查询-文本的相似性的产品排序. 每个实体都有一个实体节点,有两种或两种以上观察。 它在观测之间传递相关性,而不是作为单位本身得分. 每个检索到的观察是该轮预算的一个单位;一个实体的检索到的观察作为传记节录,即图5的检索到的实体块一并列出。 每个基准的检索最多允许5轮和64帧。 周尺度检索每回合使用16个单位,最多6个单位可能是观测,最多3个单位来自一个实体,对实体的数目没有限制. MultiHop-EgoQA每回合使用三个单元,其中最多一个可能是观测. 在每一个基准上,控制器和答题模型是Quen3.5-35B,它或者在本地服务的vLLM实例上被调用,其上下文窗口扩展至与YARN的1M令牌,或者通过OpenRouter的qwen3.5-flash端点,同一检查站的主机形式. GEB和MAGIC-Video共享一个零星的内存:30秒字幕和它们衍生的话题与事件摘要,每次搜索后注入. 摘要从标题中摘出一次,不取决于实体。 对于时间 t t 问到的问题,内存在 t t 之前重新索引到节点.

blocks.en: Table 5 summarizes the memory built for the EgoLife week, and Table 6 counts the nodes and edges of the three memory frameworks on the graph a question at the end of the week retrieves over. At the selected operating point, association groups 257,974 observations ( 83.7 % 83.7\% of all) into 27,446 entities of two or more observations, 15,365 of which span more than one day. Beside the shared episodic memory, the memory graph holds one node per tracked observation and one per entity with two or more observations, so its size follows the number of tracked observations, about 49 per 30-second clip. The memory is written once, offline, and serves every later question.
blocks.zh: 表5总结了为EgoLife周构建的内存,表6将三个内存框架的节点和边缘计算在图上,这个周末的问题被检索. 在选定的操作点,协会团体257 974次观测(占总数的83.7%)分为27 446个实体,其中15 365次观测超过一天。 除了共享的偶联内存外,内存图还持有每个跟踪观测的1个节点和每个实体有2个或更多观测的1个节点,因此其大小跟随跟踪观测的数量,约为每30秒的49个. 内存是写过一次的,离线的,并服务于以后的每一个问题.

blocks.en: Table 5: Scale of the memory built for the EgoLife week. Entities are counted once each, including those carried across several days; the seven named people are one entity each.
blocks.zh: 表5:为EgoLife周而建的内存规模. 每一个实体都计算一次,包括数天携带的实体;七个被点名的人各为一个实体。

blocks.en: The frozen memory lets us count how often a described name fails to identify an instance. Two observations of one clip are proven to be different objects by the same-frame separation test of Appendix A , which uses geometry alone and does not depend on the association. In the EgoLife week, 89,888 such pairs carry the same described name, and they occur in 5,804 of the 6,266 clips (92.6%). In the other direction, under our association, 77.2% of the 22,401 object entities seen more than once are described under two or more distinct names (an air conditioner is also an air conditioning unit and a wall-mounted air conditioner ), so a memory keyed by the described name both merges different instances and splits one instance.
blocks.zh: 被冻结的记忆让我们可以计算一个被描述的名字有多少次无法识别一个实例. 一个片段的两个观测结果通过附录A的同帧分离测试被证明是不同的物体,它只使用几何,并不依赖于关联. 在"EgoLife周"中,89,888对这样的配对搭载了相同的描述名称,它们出现在6,266个剪辑中的5,804个(92.6%). 另一方面,在我们的联系下,超过一次看到的22,401个物体实体的77.2%在两个或多个不同的名称下描述(一个空调机也是一个空调机和一个墙挂式空调机),因此由被描述的名称键入的记忆既会合并不同的实例,又会分裂一个实例.

blocks.en: Table 6: Memory statistics for the EgoLife A1 week , counted on the memory a question asked at the end of the week retrieves over. WorldMM is not one graph: it keeps a HippoRAG graph per caption granularity (passage and extracted-entity vertices, weighted relation edges) beside separate semantic-triple and visual-clip indices. GEB and MAGIC-Video share the episodic memory (episode, clip and temporal edges). GEB adds one node per tracked observation and one per entity with two or more observations. MAGIC-Video adds its text-derived entity and triple layer.
blocks.zh: 表6:EgoLife A1周的记忆统计, WorldMM并不是一个图:它除了单独的语义-三元指数和视觉-clip指数之外,还保留着每个标题颗粒的HippoRAG图(通过和提取-实体的顶点,加权关系边缘)。 GEB和MAGIC-Video分享了瞬间记忆(集成,剪辑和时间边缘). 每个跟踪观测增加一个节点,每个实体增加一个节点,有两个或两个以上的观测。 MAGIC-Video增加了其文本衍生的实体和三层.

blocks.en: We measure the query-time cost of the memory of GEB on the 50 Ego-R1-Bench questions. The searches issued in an evaluation in the setting of Section 4.1 are run again on one A100, without the controller and the answer model, against the memory of the whole week, which is at least as large as the memory any question sees, so the times below are upper bounds. Each search traverses the memory graph of Table 6 with no language-model call, and its time covers retrieval and the formatting of the returned context. A search takes 5.6 s on average (median 5.1 s, 90th percentile 8.6 s), and a question, with 2.42 searches, spends 13.6 s in retrieval.
blocks.zh: 我们在50个Ego-R1-Bench问题上测量了GEB记忆的查询时间成本. 在第4.1节设定的评价中发布的搜索再次运行在一个A100上,没有控制器和答案模型,与整个周的内存相对应,这至少是像任何问题所看到的内存一样大,所以下面的时间是上限. 每次搜索都绕过表6的内存图,没有语言模式调用,其时间涵盖了回文的检索和格式化. 搜索平均需要5.6s(中间值5.1s,第90百分位数8.6s),一个问题,有2.42搜索,在检索中花费13.6s.

blocks.en: Both benchmarks use the protocol under which the published numbers in Table 1 were obtained ( Li et al., 2026a ) : participant A1, with the recording up to the query time visible (Section 4.1 ). Two EgoLifeQA questions (71 and 73) cannot be answered from their options, one with duplicated options and one whose gold option is identical to another, and count as wrong for every system we run. Multiple-choice answers are scored by exact match.
blocks.zh: 这两项基准都采用获得表1中公布数字的规程(Li等人,2026a):参与者A1,记录直到查询时间可见(第4.1节)。 两个EgoLifeQA问题(71和73)无法从其选项中解答,一个是重复选项,一个是黄金选项与另一个选项完全相同,对我们运行的每个系统来说都是错误的. 多重选择的答案是通过精确的匹配来得到的.

blocks.en: Figure 3 a evaluates the 484 questions with an annotated evidence window. We count an evidence hit when that window overlaps a 30-second caption or a described observation received by the answer model. An observation contributes the contextual window used to generate its description (Appendix A ). Coarser episode summaries are not counted in this measure. Coverage measures access to temporally relevant context, not the correctness of the observation’s identity assignment.
blocks.zh: 图3 a用附加说明的证据窗口评估484个问题。 当窗口与30秒字幕或解答模型收到的描述观察重叠时,我们计算出一个被击中的证据。 一种观察会贡献用来生成其描述的背景窗口(Appendix A ). 压缩机集摘要不计算在本计量中. 涵盖范围衡量与时间相关的背景,而不是观察身份分配的正确性。

blocks.en: The benchmark releases 1,080 questions over 360 three-minute segments of Ego4D videos (854 × \times 480, 30 fps, no audio track). MAGIC-Video, WorldMM and GEB build their memory on 10-second units from the same captions and visual units. MAGIC-Video adds its name-keyed entities and triples, and WorldMM its separate episodic, semantic and visual stores. The multi-granularity aggregation and the chains summarize hours and have no content on a three-minute clip, so the shared episodic memory has a single granularity there. Our observations are tracked and described on 10-second clips from their own frames only, and associated across the clip’s 18 segments by the same visual association as at week scale. A 10-second observation is one unit of the timeline it links to. GEB retrieves three units per round, of which at most one may be an observation, for at most five rounds under the frame cap in Appendix A . MAGIC-Video also retrieves three units per round, whereas WorldMM retrieves up to three units from each of its episodic, semantic, and visual stores. The additional MAGIC-Video comparison increases its allowance to six units per round while retaining the controller, answer model, and scoring protocol. Because these allowances need not produce equal amounts of context, Table 3 also reports the fraction of the clip covered by received units. A clip is 18 episodes, so 16 units would return most of it in one round. The controller and the answer model are those of Section 4.1 , and frames enter the answering context only inside a retrieved visual unit.
blocks.zh: 基准在360个3分钟的Ego4D视频段(854×\times 480,30 fps,无音频音轨)上发布了1,080个问题. MAGIC-Video,WorldMM和GEB从相同的标题和视觉单元中用10秒的单位来构建他们的记忆. MAGIC-Video增加了它的名键实体和三重体,而WorldMM又增加了单独的零星,语义和视觉商店. 多角聚合和链条总结了小时,在3分钟的剪辑上没有内容,所以共享的偶联内存就有一个单一的颗粒性. 我们的观察仅用10秒的片段跟踪和描述, 并用与每周规模相同的视觉联系, 10秒观察是它链接到的时间的一个单位. GEB每回合回收三个单位,其中最多一个可能是观察,最多在附录A框盖下回收五个单位。 MAGIC-Video还从每轮取回3个单元,而WorldMM则从每个零星、语义和视觉商店取回最多3个单元。 增加的MAGIC-Video比较将其允许量提高到每回合6个单位,同时保留控制器,答题模型和评分协议. 由于这些津贴不一定产生同等数额的上下文,表3还报告了收到的单位所覆盖的片段的一小部分。 片段是18集,所以16个单元会以一回合的形式归还大部分. 控制器和答题模型是第4.1节的,帧仅在检索到的视觉单元内输入答题上下文.

blocks.en: Answers follow the benchmark’s open-ended prompt and are parsed and scored with its released code. mIoP, mIoG and mIoU compare the predicted evidence intervals with the annotation, averaged over the questions that predicted an interval, and IoU@0.3 is computed over all questions. Both come from the released script run unchanged on our predictions. Sentence similarity compares the answer with the reference (all-MiniLM-L6-v2). The benchmark’s 1–10 grading prompt scores the 724 questions with a worded reference and runs on gpt-oss-120b rather than the answer model. The grounding metrics and the sentence similarity involve no judge, so the rows Table 2 copies from the benchmark paper are on the same scale as ours in those columns. Among those rows, Human is scored on 10% of the questions, GeLM is fine-tuned on the benchmark’s training set, and the caption pipeline reads all 180 captions of a clip. Published grading scores use GPT-4o and are not reported. Instead we ran the released inference code and weights of every open-source system (InternVL2-8B, LLaVA-NeXT-Video-7B, TimeChat-7B, VTimeLLM-7B, the LLaVA-NeXT caption pipeline with Llama-3.1-8B, and GeLM-7B on its released features) and scored their answers with the same gpt-oss-120b judge. Their grounding metrics and sentence similarity match the reported values within one point for every system except the caption pipeline, whose mIoP and mIoG are two to three points below the reported values. GPT-4o itself is not re-run, so every comparison of grading scores in the paper is on one judge. Evidence coverage is read off the answering context: a caption unit or a described observation covers an evidence interval when their windows overlap. The confidence intervals of Table 3 are computed over all 1,080 questions, each question’s value being its mean over the three runs, and the judge score is averaged over the 724 questions with a worded reference.
blocks.zh: 答案遵循基准的无限制提示,用其发布的代码解析并打分。 mIoP,mIoG和mIoU比较了预测的证据间隔和注释,平均是预测间隔的问题,IoU@0.3是对所有问题的计算. 两者都来自发布的剧本 运行不变的我们的预测。 句子相似性将答案与引用(all-MiniLM-L6-v2)相比较. 基准的1-10分速率将724个问题评为有文字参考,并运行在gpt-oss-120b而不是答案模式上。 基准参数和句子的相似性不涉及法官,因此,基准文件中的表2副本与我们在这些栏目中的比例相同。 在这些行中,Human在10%的问题上得分,GeLM在基准训练集上进行了微调,字幕管道读取了全部180个片段的字幕。 公布的分数使用GPT-4o,不报告. 相反,我们运行了每个开源系统的释放推论代码和权重(InternVL2-8B,LLaVA-NEXT-Video-7B,TimeChat-7B,VTimeLLM-7B,LLaVA-NEXT字幕管道,Llama-31-8B,以及GelM-7B的释放特性),并以相同的gpt-oss-120b判断器来打分他们的答案. 它们的定位指标和句子相似性与除标题管道以外的每个系统的1点内报告值一致,其mIoP和mIoG低于报告值2-3点。 GPT-4o本身并没有重新运行,因此论文中每分分数的比较都是在一个裁判上. 证据覆盖从回答语境中读出:一个标题单位或一个描述的观察涵盖其窗口重叠时的证据间隔. 表3的置信间隔是对所有1 080个问题的计算,每个问题的价值是其三个周期的平均值,法官的平均得分是724个问题,并附有文字参考。

blocks.en: Test@Week is the same EgoLife recording as our main experiments, with 200 human-written questions and no query timestamp, so the whole week is observable and the memory built for EgoLifeQA is used unchanged. Test@Day is a 23.6-hour gameplay livestream with 200 questions. The three memory frameworks share its 30-second captions, which name the game and copy on-screen names because the questions refer to the game’s entities by name. Static interface overlays (health bars, icons, the streamer’s name tag) are not physical objects and are excluded from the memory, and the association thresholds are set by the inspection of Appendix A . Answers are free text, and the benchmark’s GPT-5 judge scores each 0–5, mapped to 1, 0.5, or 0. The Qwen3.5-35B row of Table 1 is the answer model alone. It reads 1536 frames sampled uniformly over the whole recording, the frame count of the published Qwen3-VL rows, sent as one video through the model’s own video processor with each frame kept at 512 pixels on its longer side, without transcript or thinking and under the same judge. Table 7 varies the input of the answer model alone, and Table 1 reports the strongest of these settings.
blocks.zh: Test@Week是和我们的主要实验一样的EgoLife录制,有200个人写的问题,没有查询时间戳,因此整个星期都是可观察的,为EgoLifeQA构建的内存使用不变. 测试@ Day是一个23.6小时的游戏游戏直播流,有200个问题. 三个内存框架共享其30秒字幕,这些字幕将游戏命名,并在屏幕上复制名称,因为问题按名称提及游戏实体. 静态界面覆盖(健康条,图标,流体名标记)不是物理对象,被排除在内存之外,关联阈值由检查附录A确定. 答案是免费的文本,基准的GPT-5评分是每0–5, 映射到1, 0. 表1的Qwen3.5-35B行单是答案模型. 它阅读了1536帧在整个录制中统一取样,即已出版的Quen3-VL行的帧数,通过模型自己的视频处理器作为一个视频发送,每个帧保存在更长的侧面512像素,没有文字记录或思考,在同一个法官之下. 表7仅对答案模型的输入有差异,表1报告了其中最强的设置.

Unmarked entries in Tables 1 , 16 , and 10 are our runs. These runs access only recordings preceding the query time on EgoLifeQA and Ego-R1-Bench, and the complete recording on MM-Lifelong.
On EgoLifeQA and Ego-R1-Bench the Qwen3.5-35B row reads 256 frames sampled up to the query time together with their captions. The long-video models (LongVA-7B ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , InternVideo2.5-8B ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , VideoLLaMA3-7B ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , Molmo2-8B ( Clark et al., 2026 ) , Video-XL-2-8B ( Qin et al., 2025 ) and VideoChat-Flash-7B ( Li et al., 2026b ) ) run from their public checkpoints with their own inference code and read 256 frames sampled uniformly at 1 fps under one open-ended prompt. VideoChat-Flash-7B receives the frames as a 1 fps video. The agentic rows run every text role on gpt-oss-120b and every frame-reading role on Qwen3.5-35B. AVP ( Wang et al., 2026 ) is a plan-observe-reflect agent (three rounds, 512 frames per step at 384 pixels, a 1,024-frame budget) whose synthesizer returns a short answer. Ego-R1 ( Tian et al., 2026 ) runs its released prompt, tool schemas and twelve-turn loop, with the fine-tuned agent replaced by gpt-oss-120b and the video and frame tools reading our 1 fps frames with Qwen3.5-35B. It uses its released hierarchical caption database for Test@Week and, for Test@Day, a database of the same three levels written by gpt-oss-120b from our 30-second captions. EgoButler ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , in Table 16 only, runs EgoLife’s released EgoRAG code unchanged on the same 30-second captions, every call on gpt-oss-120b. blocks.en: The EgoLifeQA variants without association and with identity keyed by name retain every observation description as a searchable unit under the full model’s retrieval-unit and frame limits (Appendix A ). For descriptions appended to captions, the observation and entity nodes are removed, and the retrieval allowance is adjusted to approximately match the full model’s mean answering-context token and frame counts. Matching therefore concerns the delivered context, rather than the number of retrieved units. Withholding biography text retains the indexed observations and graph connections. The index-only variant withholds that text from both models, while the answer-model-only variant keeps the controller’s searches fixed and removes it only from the final answering context.

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows a question on which GEB and the baseline diverge, who wore a hat while walking in the park . blocks.en: This section gives the prompts with which GEB describes observations and searches the memory. Figures 6 and 7 give the description prompt on EgoLife, sent to the vision-language model once per observation with the crops and scene frames of Appendix A . On MultiHop-EgoQA the prompt keeps the same rules without the caption and transcript lines, so each observation is described from its own frames, and people are referred to by what is seen because the benchmark names no one. On the Test@Day stream the actors are game characters, and the prompt asks for the name the game gives each of them, since the questions refer to them by name. Test@Week uses the EgoLife memory unchanged. Figures 8 to 10 give the controller prompt on EgoLife. At each round the controller reads the question and the round history and returns a JSON decision, either a search with its query or the answer. On the other benchmarks the controller prompt has the same structure, with the description of the recording, the time format and the examples written for it.
blocks.zh: 本节给出GEB描述观察和搜索内存的提示. 图6和图7给出了EgoLife的描述,每次用附录A的作物和场景框观察一次就送交视觉语言模型。 在MultiHop-EgoQA上,即时保持相同的规则,没有标题和笔录线条,所以每个观察都从自己的框架来描述,人们被看到的东西来称呼,因为基准名称无人. 在Test@Day流中,演员是游戏角色,即时询问游戏给每个角色的名字,因为问题指的是他们的名字. 测试@ Week 使用 EgoLife 内存不变. 图8至图10给出控制器关于EgoLife的快速信息. 控制器在每个回合读出问答历史,并返回一个JSON决定,或者用它的查询或答案进行搜索. 在其他基准上,控制器的提示具有相同的结构,对记录,时间格式和为它写的例子都有描述.

blocks.en: Appendix G Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录G 限制

blocks.en: GEB estimates instance identity from visual evidence, and reliable tracking and re-identification across long videos remain open challenges. Association errors may assign an observation to the wrong biography, while contextual descriptions may attribute a nearby action to the wrong entity. Retrieval over the larger memory graph also incurs higher latency than caption-only retrieval (Appendix B ). These limitations suggest concrete directions for further improving association reliability, action attribution, and retrieval efficiency within the proposed framework.
blocks.zh: GEB从视觉证据中估算出实例身份,在长视频中进行可靠的跟踪和重新识别仍然是公开的挑战。 关联错误可能会为错误的传记指派一个观察,而背景描述可能将附近的动作归于错误的实体. 对较大的内存图进行检索也会产生比只使用标题的检索(Appendix B )更高的延迟. 这些限制为在拟议框架内进一步提高关联可靠性、行动归属和检索效率提出了具体方向。
